title: Comments as a steering signal
description:
Decision (2026-10-21): comments are wanted and solicited. Comment text is a steering signal for Cyclotrons and AI: it feeds Cyclotron feedback and priming as a text rationale next to the vote or decision it explains.

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestones 5 and 7). Depends on reader accounts; subject to the moderation epic (siblings). Related: Cyclotron priming work PPY-7227ac; Cyclotron relevance epic PPY-b0396f.

Children: public comments; prompting for a rationale at vote time; comment text into Cyclotron feedback.
Definition of Done: signed-in readers post comments that are shown publicly under the moderation mode, and comment text reaches Cyclotron feedback with attribution.
